welcome_message:
Create an AAI agent application

A tool-using agent with an application-owned async loop, governed prompt, Pydantic outputs and tools, tracing, trajectory-aware evaluation, feedback, a native MLflow Agent Server deployment, and an optional LangGraph recipe.

project_name.description: Project and bundle name. NOTE: apply template updates deliberately — generated projects record their template version in .aai-template.json
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

application_name.description: Application identifier used in tags, traces, and the Databricks App name (maximum 26 characters so the generated -dev name stays within the Apps limit)
application_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Use 1-26 lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; start with a letter and do not end with a hyphen.

repository_url.description: Required absolute HTTPS URL of this project's real Git repository; Hub registration rejects example and placeholder URLs
repository_url.pattern_match_failure_message: Use an absolute HTTPS repository URL without credentials, spaces, a query string, or a fragment.

catalog.description: Unity Catalog catalog (also hosts the prompt registry)

schema.description: Unity Catalog schema (prompt registry and the registered agent model)

model_provider.description: Model provider. Choose `databricks` (recommended default: gateway-ready serving endpoint) unless your team already operates its own Foundry resource. Application code only uses the logical name

model_deployment.description: Databricks serving endpoint name or Foundry deployment name

foundry_endpoint.description: Foundry project endpoint ending in /api/projects/<project> (only asked for Foundry models)

judge_deployment.description: Approved gateway-fronted Databricks serving endpoint used by LLM judges

prompt_name.description: Registered prompt name in the Unity Catalog prompt registry
prompt_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

prompt_version.description: Exact immutable Prompt Registry version evaluated by release_gate and loaded by the App; after registering a new prompt, update this value before deployment
prompt_version.pattern_match_failure_message: Use a positive integer Prompt Registry version; mutable aliases are not accepted.

include_serving.description: Include the Databricks Apps + MLflow Agent Server deployment. Requires model_provider=databricks; direct Foundry projects omit deployment until routed through a Databricks external-model endpoint

experiment_id.description: ID of the existing MLflow experiment named in aai-platform.yml; the externally onboarded App identity requires CAN_EDIT

app_usage_policy_id.description: Externally provisioned Databricks Apps usage policy ID

aai_core_volume.description: Unity Catalog volume holding aai-core wheels

aai_core_pip_source.description: pip-installable aai-core source used only by credential-free CI; MUST resolve to exactly aai_core_version (default: the release git tag; for an internal index use 'aai-core=={{.aai_core_version}}'). Runtime jobs always install the checksum-pinned volume wheel

success_message:
{{.project_name}} created.

Next steps:
  1. cd {{.project_name}}
  2. python3.12 scripts/setup_dev.py     # preflight + isolated setup
  3. make check                          # tests + deterministic gate
  4. python scripts/register_prompt.py   # note the immutable version
  5. Set variables.prompt_version.default in databricks.yml to that version
  6. python evals/evaluate.py --prompt-version <version>  # note decision_run_id
  7. python scripts/promote_prompt.py --version <version> --decision-run-id <run-id> --to validation
  8. Complete the external App onboarding and one-time bundle bind in README.md
  9. databricks bundle deploy -t dev
 10. databricks bundle run release_gate -t dev
{{if and (eq .include_serving "yes") (eq .model_provider "databricks")}} 11. databricks bundle run agent_app -t dev  # same prompt version; only after the gate{{else}} 11. Serving resources were intentionally omitted for this configuration. Add a gateway-fronted Databricks endpoint and regenerate or add the reviewed deployment resources before serving.{{end}} Run `make help` for every target.
